findings.evidence: “Pin down the requested behavior, the runtime/framework and the architectural layer” and “Search on the behavior and its synonyms” restate ordinary code-search practice rather than adding expert knowledge. The body mixes this generic activation material with stronger provenance, mock-versus-usage and explicit-status guidance.
findings.fix: Compress steps 1–2 into: “For the requested feature, structural, integration or testing patterns, locate behavior-relevant implementations in the appropriate runtime and layer, then verify their callers and tests.” Retain the provenance deduplication, mock-versus-usage distinction and explicit-status rules as the substantive guidance.

findings.evidence: “Report one example per materially distinct approach” conflicts with the later limit “at most 3 variations per pattern type” when a search finds four or more distinct approaches. Equivalent variants have a grouping rule, but omitted distinct approaches have no reporting outcome.
findings.fix: Make step 4 explicitly bounded: return up to three distinct approaches in file-path order, list any additional distinct approaches with citations under an “Additional approaches not expanded” heading, and expand those snippets when the caller requests exhaustive coverage.
